subject: Visibility Synapse Alliance: connector bundling & pilot plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@datadog.com>, Priya Verma <priya@grafana.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi@signalops.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Visibility Synapse Alliance: connector bundling & pilot plan

Hi Alex / Priya / Ravi —

Thanks for taking the time on the call yesterday. Quick follow-up with a proposed minimal scope so we can get a pilot out in customers' hands within 6–8 weeks. High-level asks below; attached is a working Mutual Action Plan (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN-v1.xlsx).

Proposed pilot scope:
- Bundle Redwood's OTLP relay + lightweight connector for Datadog and Grafana dashboards (no heavy SDK changes)
- Two pilot customers: one SaaS (traces + metrics) and one enterprise (logs + security telemetry)
- Duration: 60 days with agreed SLOs for latency and sample retention

Technical pre-reqs we need to validate:
- Datadog: ingest schema for plugin (sample events, API rate limits) — Alex, can you share the minimal ingestion spec?
- Grafana: dashboard JSON templates and suggested panels we should ship with the connector — Priya, any starter templates?
- SignalOps: proposed operational runbook for escalation and support handoffs — Ravi, can you attach a short ops play?

Commercial ask:
- Co-sell messaging + a reseller SKU for a pilot bundle (12-week trial license)
- Standard revshare split proposal: 60/40 to Redwood for usage+support. Ben / Laura, can you propose the commercial skeleton?

Next steps / owners:
- Datadog: Alex to send ingest spec (target by Mon 11/9)
- Grafana: Priya to share dashboard templates (target by Tue 11/10)
- SignalOps: Ravi to give an ops play and SOC access checklist (target by Wed 11/11)
- Redwood: Marissa / Ben to propose pilot MQL list and canary customers (draft by Mon 11/9)

Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN-v1.xlsx (outline milestones, responsibilities, basic SLA)

Appreciate the quick turnaround — if we can lock these items this week we can get contracts and a marketplace listing queued.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0142

Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Visibility Synapse Alliance: connector bundling & pilot plan

Marissa / team —

Thanks — this looks sensible. I've attached a short ingest spec (datadog_ingest_spec.pdf) that covers the minimal fields we need for metrics and traces. Quick notes:
- API rate limits: pilot SKU should be under the standard partner soft-limits but we can request a temporary lift for initial onboarding
- Authentication: API keys are fine for pilot; for production we'll want SSO + service account recommendations
- Sample events: include a mapping table to our event model (see page 2)

We'll be able to produce a basic python ingestion example by Thu 11/12 if that helps the engineering POC.

Alex Ramos
Partner Solutions Engineer, Datadog
alex.ramos@datadog.com

Team — quick internal note before we loop back to the partners.

I like the 60/40 starting point for pilot economics but want to preserve flexibility for enterprise deals with managed services. Ask: can we build two commercial tracks in the MAP?

Proposed commercial tracks:
- Pilot/resell SKU: short-term license + partner-assisted onboarding (60/40 split, automatic renewal opt-out)
- Enterprise managed: platform fee + implementation SOW (custom pricing, negotiated with partner uplift)

Operational items to confirm before pilot kickoff:
- Marketplace packaging: who owns the listing and legal review? (Laura to confirm)
- Can we instrument token-level cost telemetry for pilot customers? (Jordan to scope)
- Support SLAs: SignalOps to own Level 1 for partner onboarding; Redwood L2 for inference runtime issues

Action: Laura, please start the marketplace listing checklist and legal contact. Jordan, build a quick token-cost dashboard prototype for pilot metrics. Marissa, I'll join the 11/10 technical kickoff.

Ben
VP Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Priya Verma <priya@grafana.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@datadog.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi@signalops.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Visibility Synapse Alliance: connector bundling & pilot plan

Marissa & team —

Grafana is excited to partner here. A few items from our side:
- Dashboard templates: attaching a starter JSON (grafana_dashboard_template.json) — these are opinionated panels for tracing latency, error-rate heatmaps, and a guardrail dashboard for prefix/KV cache miss rates
- Packaging: recommend a marketplace tile that includes a demo dashboard and a 1-click import for customers; we can co-author the marketplace blurb
- Field enablement: propose a joint two-hour workshop (technical + product) to align dashboards and templated alerts. Suggest Wed 11/11 09:00 PT.

A short link to a collaborative folder is here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xSynapsePilot — I dropped a suggested alert rule doc and a sample dashboard.

We can also provide a small set of sample queries (Flux/PromQL) that map to Redwood's output. If you can share expected metric names we will map them for the dashboard.

Thanks,
Priya Verma
Partner Engineering Manager, Grafana Labs
priya@grafana.com
